news.title: JcbNext sells 2.56% stake in Taiwan’s 104 Corp for RM22.62mil

recent_en: Between 30 July 2026 and 18 September 2026, JCBNEXT disposed of 849,317 shares in 104 Corporation on the Taiwan Stock Exchange for approximately RM22.62 million, reducing its stake from about 4.25% to 1.69%. The company released its consolidated quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026 on 28 August 2026.
notable_en: The company disposed of 849,317 shares in 104 Corporation between 30 July 2026 and 18 September 2026 for approximately RM22.62 million, reducing its stake to 1.69%.
